What would change my mind: if Micron's move reverses hard on volume in the next few sessions, or if Arista and GE Aerospace actually confirm their setups with real volume behind the move - both are within a point or two of my stated levels and stay at the top of my watchlist.

## The one name that cleared the bar: MU (Micron)
Not a trigger-alert name and not in this run's deep-research focus set (no options/insider/13F
data was available in the bundle), so I built the case directly from live search. This morning
Micron reported Q3 FY26 results: revenue $41.5B (beat), EPS $25.11 vs $20.20 est (+24%), gross

melt-up, it's a resumption on real news after weakness. This is a post-earnings-drift trade: the
binary already resolved this morning, and the thesis is that the market hasn't yet re-rated the
multiple to the newly-disclosed demand visibility.

Sized deliberately small: risk-based sizing at 1% of equity, halved for the momentum-unwind flag,
against an 11.8% stop distance (1.4x the 8.38% ATR floor) = ~$42. This is a same-day entry into a
gap with no confirmed base underneath it and an incomplete research bundle (no options/insider/13F
data this run) — real chase risk that the small size and wide-of-noise stop are meant to respect.
I will scale in on confirmation (max 2 adds, only above cost), not average up on hope.
